notes.title: Fan Pack DLC + Important Update!
notes.content:
Hello, good boys and girls! [i](Please read till the end-this update contains important infos!)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096502/3070a4746a600c96bdb4ae6f0d594690ba6ce17b.png[/img]

Well, we're finally there. [b]Oppaidius Desert Island! released on Steam about 12 days ago.[/b]

At the moment, the game is going well, but it suffers from a lack of reviews. Right now, only 12 on Steam, and 1 on VNDB.org. If you enjoyed the game, please consider to leave a review.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38096502/484a4c10c069ca7f53125246c1767219e87c2a71.png[/img]

Also, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659110/Oppaidius_Desert_Island_Fan_Pack/]Fan Pack DLC has been released.[/url] It contains:
 - Soundtrack selection (5 mp3 files)[b]*[/b]
 - 4 uncompressed original PSD files, used for the Live2D animations of the XXX scenes in the game
 - Exclusive nude version final wallpaper (only available there)
 - Handwritten "thank you" message

[i][b]*Angela's Theme - Octopus' Theme - Rika's Theme - Dan-dan's Theme[/b] by Luca Della Regina
[b]Angela's Theme Arrange Ver.[/b] by Tsuyoshi Kaneko[/i]

It costs 9.99$. This will help support us and our next projects.

So, the game has been released according to original Kickstarter campaign plan. It wasn't easy, since during the last year me and Matteo worked together only via Skype, due to Covid issues. But in the end, with a lot of passion and a bit of hours of sleep less, dealing with acid reflux and all the other things in our life, we managed to have fulfilled the promises, and we are quite happy about that.

Another [b]important thing[/b] I want to share with you guys: the game features all of the Stretch Goals from original Kickstarter campaign, of course. [url=https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/029/548/751/1b0278422c1dd12758e2b5b402f635cc_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=680&fit=max&v=1592751634&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=71adb106855f21addb5bd77d01d488cf]In the end, unfortunately we couldn't reach the 13,500€ goal.[/url] That goal would have added to the game [b]2 extra "XXX" scenes,[/b] fully animated with Live2D. Well, since this is probably the last Oppaidius game... I didn't want to to keep any regret about this project, so [b]I tried to add 2 extra scenes anyway.[/b] One is a fully animated scene, just done by hand by me. About 37 frames, traditional animation (unfortunately no more money to do it with Live2D like the others!). The other one was done in Live2D, but it is not a "100%" new scene, just a... [i]"variant"[/i] of another scene. When you'll see it, you'll get it.

So... in the end the game got a bit more than what it was funded for... 

Sorry for this little digression, but sometimes it is sad to read nasty comments about the game, or about the crowdfunding campaigns in general. Of corse, luck always plays a major part, but passion never lacked for a single day during the whole development, since the start of the whole Tropical Cruise/Desert Island saga project, back at the beginning of 2019.

Thank you very much for reading so far! I want to thank you all again for your support every day! 

[b]The game is out. We are a relatively small community, so I know every one of you could feel this game as "his own", as well. Please enjoy this moment, it belongs to all of you.[/b]

Vittorio and the team

P.S.: Second best moment of the month, after the game release... was [url=https://twitter.com/vittoriogiorgi/status/1404021788129038337/photo/1]Shibuya Kaho with my Famicase cart![/url] I am a huge Shibuya Kaho fan, so it was just... mindblowing! [url=https://youtu.be/WPLdYN-gEjs]Check it out! (The part about my game is at 7:40)[/url]

notes.title: May Update! + RELEASE DATE INFO!
notes.content:
Hello, good boys and girls!

Oppaidius Desert Island! is essentially completed, but we need few more days in order to fix the last things. It is fully playable from start to finish, but unfortunately the endings/unlocked stuff/achievements system has some weird behavior, so we need to work on it a bit more. I don't want to release a game with bugs on D1, we're trying to make it without issues from 1.0 version already, if possible. Also, this game is HUGE compared to the ones we did in the past, so the 2-3 days working on the last adjustments are just not enough this time around.

We plan to submit the game build to Steam in the next few days, so if they accept it t[b]he game will probably be released next week on Tuesday/Wednesday[/b] (during the weekend, Steam review system of course is not updated). If Steam "bounces" us off, we need to add at least 2/3 days more. Crossing fingers...

I'm sorry for that (I probably underestimated the final adjustments time required, I expected it to be way less than a week, but it wasn't enough), but let me tell you, I'm [b]really happy[/b] with the final result! The game is almost 100% like I imagined it in my mind years ago, and I hope you guys will be [b]happy[/b] too, to play it and to read your names in the ending credits.

Monthly fanart for May is [b]Iroha[/b] from [i]Samurai Shodown:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36052807/7588909e8841935beadd8e9cc449acf3120233fb.png[/img]

As always, exclusive stuff is available on [url=https://www.patreon.com/vittoriogiorgi]Patreon,[/url] like this NSFW version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36052807/f3227ef03ca0f2a53342bbe94fe68ed1617acad0.png[/img]

For June, the monthly poll on [url=https://discord.gg/taFcKad]Oppaidius Discord[/url] was won by [b]Franziska von Karma[/b] from [i]Ace Attorney[/i]! It will be released during June.

As always, [b]topless[/b] and alternate versions of the fanarts could be unlocked on [url=https://www.patreon.com/vittoriogiorgi]Patreon[/url] starting from 2€, but if you're already a backer from 20€ and up, you can access to the topless versions [b]for free![/b] Just [url=https://discord.gg/taFcKad]join Oppaidius Discord![/url]

I will keep you guys updated about the game release, as soon as Steam replies you will be the first to know. On here and on Discord.

Thank you very much for your support, as always!

Vittorio and the team

notes.title: FREE DEMO available!
notes.content:
Hello, good boys and girls!

The [b]Steam Game Festival[/b] started 2 days ago! And yes, we are a part of it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36052807/9af7e34b9d21a82192ccd049a06300ed8b5d4e02.png[/img]

During this festival you can:  

[b]Chat with devs[/b] -not a big issue about Oppaidius, you can already chat with us everyday on [url=https://discord.gg/eb3Xp2f]Oppaidius Discord[/url] and by the way we are not that hilarious ;)

[b]Watch livestreams[/b] -not applicable here again, livestreams for adult games are not allowed by the event 

[b]Download exclusive demo[/b] -YES! That is actually a thing! [b]Oppaidius Desert Island! demo is ALREADY AVAILABLE,[/b] and you can download it [b]NOW![/b] Head over to Desert Island page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1345340/Oppaidius_Desert_Island/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1345340/Oppaidius_Desert_Island/[/url] [i](as always, you have to be logged in Steam with adult content set "on")[/i] 

You can finally have a glimpse of what we did in the past months, thanks to your support!

- [b]The demo is available only for a week! [/b]So, still 5 days from now

- At the end of the first run you will unlock the Fast Forward mode (skip to unread text) 

- Demo save files will not be compatible with full game release 

- Of course full game will feature different endings, paths and an awesome minigame! 

- The demo is totally NSFW! 

- [b]Important! [/b]At the end of the demo you will be asked to fill a short online survey (Google Survey, no email necessary), it is quick and anonymous, please consider to do it, your opinion will help us after working on the game since the release of Tropical Cruise!


Thank you very much for your support, as always!

Vittorio and the team
